head: bcaf7a2538a10176c89dd1fddddafbe29826b56e
scope: Logind failure acceptance on private D-Bus, test-only followup
cases: logind absent through at least one failed attempt and retry: existing device remains active, late service causes resync
owned private dbus-daemon process killed and waited: supervisor reconnects on replacement address and restores device/inhibitor
health property server response withheld: sleep signal finishes teardown and releases inhibitor before 1s, below 2s RPC timeout
limitations: No system bus, physical suspend/resume, HID hardware or host sensor reads.
Private bus replacement uses injected address; production system bus reconnection not run live.
Combined post-wake cooling/RGB/theme and rate/counter providers remain acceptance items.
No frontend or native GUI rerun.
